static_assembly_scope: Native-size alpha-over QA at x=0,y=0, and two discrete horizontal offset tests. These three renders are review evidence only, not canonical assets.

static_native_assembly_findings.finding: At pan 0, the rear curb meets the combat floor without a visible open horizontal seam. Numeric alpha >127 covers the full width of L3 at y=740 and L4 at y=741.
The foreground drainage grille is visible once. L4 has the corresponding band reconstructed as ordinary floor, so no second grille was observed in the native composite.

Main left/right towers, central magenta landmark and tall spire, elevated walkway, sun and five rear lamps remain near their master positions. This is visual correspondence, not pixel-accurate extraction.

Secondary towers disappeared, especially the slender far-left tower around x=45 and towers around x=404 and x=460. Other medium skyline silhouettes were simplified or replaced. L1 reconstructs a new distant city rhythm instead of preserving every original silhouette.
L0 redraws the clouds with a denser, brighter texture. L2 redraws facade divisions and some under-bridge surfaces; L4 redraws local floor seams/reflections. No 1:1 claim is warranted.
The central tower bases have local horizontal cutoffs around the curb height. They are acceptably concealed in the fixed composite, but depth-specific motion still needs a proper engine review.

Several layers contain faint nonzero-alpha fringe or residue well beyond their visually dominant bounding box. No manual cleanup was applied; dark/light background and premultiplied-alpha behavior remain untested.

overscan.explanation: Each file is exactly the master canvas. No off-canvas continuation exists in these PNGs. Reconstructed content behind foreground occluders does not supply edge overscan.
overscan.factors_status: QA demonstration values only, not approved engine settings

observed_failures.finding: Sky or background becomes visible beyond the shifted right tower/curb/floor edges. The floor is absent from the final 32 pixels and the grille stops 36 pixels short.
Symmetric exposed strips appear on the left. The floor is absent from the first 32 pixels and the grille starts 36 pixels into the canvas.

overscan.floor_area_measurement_basis: L4 occupies y=740..886 at the visible floor boundary; 32 px translation leaves a 32 x 147 canvas band without L4. Border antialiasing is not counted as an overscan reserve.
overscan.composite_alpha_warning: The composite is still alpha 255 everywhere because L0 is opaque. This does not hide the semantic hole where sky replaces the floor.
